up: Retrieve the exact activity values (standard_value with its corresponding standard_relation and standard_units) and the chemical structures (canonical_smiles) for all compounds tested in the assay identified by CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4649945'.
sql:
SELECT
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_units,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649945'
  AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL;
